scope: One mount with the same rider in three views, and three independent empty venue backgrounds.
remarks: The mounted form preserves the actual biped tiger carrying the passenger in front.
User attachments are used only for camera composition, not environment or character design.
Individual PNG concept images; no sprite slicing or Unity import.
Loop-friendly layout experiment; seamless edge matching and running loop have not been validated.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Create ONE polished 2D game-character illustration, a full-body tiger mount AND its human passenger as one inseparable unit, SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, transparent background. Square 1536 x 1536 composition. This is an image concept for a layered racing-camera test, not a sprite sheet.
Reference 1: actual Unity tiger with rider, primary identity reference. Reference 2: actual exact side silhouette. Preserve the recognizable original creature: stout upright two-legged golden orange tiger, dark brown stripes, large white fluffy cheek ruff and muzzle, wise happy narrowed eyes, enormous rounded paws with dark claws, long striped tail with white tuft. Wears a small dark brown slightly flared traditional top hat. Carries a large crimson cylindrical luck sack on its BACK held by thick twisted golden rope, open top contains oversized gold coins with square holes and one tiny tiger cub charm peeking out. Preserve these distinctive items and silhouette, no generic quadrupedal tiger redesign.
Passenger: reinterpret the current red-haired male warrior attractively and clearly, young adult chibi fantasy adventurer, tousled burgundy-red hair, silver shoulder plates/gauntlets/boots, ivory tunic, blue inner tabard, brown trousers and leather belt. One human only. Tiger carries the small warrior securely seated in the crook of its forward arm across the front of its body, a natural supported cradled riding pose matching the reference's unusual carried mounting system. Correct awkward floating/intersections in the 3D reference. Rider's face is readable in right profile looking ahead; knees bent, boots visible, hand holds support strap. Keep rider attached to mount.
Art direction: beautiful hand-drawn high quality 2D Korean fantasy RPG character art, clean confident fine colored outlines, controlled cel shading plus gentle hand-painted gradients, warm expressive fur, clean silver highlights, appealing compact proportions. NOT a low-poly render or realistic photograph.
Camera: strict lateral profile, just 6 degrees of elevation so top planes are minimally visible, lens compression / orthographic feel; active running stride with one hind foot reaching forward and the other back. Entire hat, sack, cub, tail, passenger and both feet within frame, at least 9 percent transparent margin. Warm daylight from upper left. No background, no floor, no shadow blob, no motion trails, no grass, no UI, no labels, no watermark, no view grid. Preserve real alpha transparency.

Use case: identity-preserve, stylized-concept. Produce ONE isolated full-body 2D rear-follow-camera illustration of the EXACT SAME tiger-and-passenger unit in reference 1. Reference 1 is the approved polished 2D identity and art treatment. Reference 2 shows the actual underlying 3D model from behind, only structural help. True transparent background, square composition, no grid or multiple views.
Change the CAMERA, preserve all character design: upright stout golden tiger, dark brown stripes, huge white cheek ruff, dark brown flared hat, crimson round cylindrical sack on BACK with thick golden rope ties, gold square-hole coins and tiny orange tiger cub peeking from its top, striped tail white tip, curved dark pipe. The SAME young adult chibi male with tousled burgundy-red hair, silver shoulder armor/gauntlets/greaves, ivory-and-navy tabard, brown trousers with golden X stitching, brown leather belt and gloves. Human remains carried securely in tiger's FRONT arm like reference 1; he must NOT migrate to sitting on its back or sack. There is exactly one human rider; preserve anatomical occlusion: sack dominates back, rider's red hair, shoulder and one boot peek at the forward-right edge.
Camera: rear tracking, camera behind the subject, elevated about 20 degrees, yaw only 8 degrees from straight rear so almost symmetrical back view; tiger moving AWAY toward the upper center of the image with very slight leftward lean for a left-hand racing bend. Hat back, sack's back, rear torso and heel/sole planes visible. Keep identity's bag front plain or with only a subtle circular decorative emblem, no text. The unit is in a dynamic two-leg running stride, natural supported passenger, no extra legs. Whole unit centered with 10 percent margin on all sides including tail, paws, hat. Same beautiful 2D colored linework/cel-shaded hand-painted fantasy game style and same warm upper-left daylight as reference 1; not 3D. No background, floor, shadow oval, UI, letters, frame, motion streaks, or watermark. Real alpha transparency.

Use case: identity-preserve, stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated full-body overhead OBLIQUE view of the exact same tiger mount carrying the same human passenger in reference 1. Reference 1 is the approved 2D art/identity. Other references show the actual 3D construction only; correct awkward intersections. True transparent background, square single image, not a turnaround sheet.
Camera is HIGH ABOVE at 55 degrees downward, front-side three-quarter aerial camera, clearly showing the TOP of hat, shoulders, open sack, rider hair and large feet. The unit is facing and running diagonally toward BOTTOM RIGHT (southeast on screen), to composite onto an aerial racing bend. Face and side/front of tiger and rider visible from above, foreshortening convincing. Not eye-level and not a directly vertical map icon.
Preserve EXACT design and proportions from reference 1: stocky upright TWO-LEGGED golden tiger with dark brown stripes, soft white cheek ruff, smiling narrowed eyes, large dark-clawed paws, flared dark brown hat and curved pipe, long white-tipped striped tail. Large open crimson cylindrical luck sack on its BACK lashed with thick twisted golden ropes, square-holed gold coins, one tiny tiger cub peeking out. Same tousled burgundy-haired young adult male fantasy warrior passenger, silver armor on shoulders/arms/boots, ivory/navy tabard, brown trousers with golden X stitches, brown gloves. Carry him securely in the crook of the FRONT arm in the exact same supported seated cradling arrangement as reference 1, not riding astride or seated inside sack. Two figures as one connected unit, only one human and one tiny decorative tiger cub. Keep beautiful fine colored outlines and controlled cel shading with gentle painterly gradients from reference 1, same warm sunlight upper left. Dynamic running stride, silhouette readable, no additions. Entire hat, sack, tail, rider, feet fit within frame with 12 percent margin. No background, grass, ground, floor shadow, UI, labels, text, motion trails or watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept, background painting. Create ONE polished 2D game racing environment background, WIDE landscape 1792x1024. This is the empty background layer for a horizontally scrolling SIDE TRACKING view. Use the two actual Unity scene captures as the sole environment identity reference; they are rough geometry that must be beautifully repainted, not copied as low-poly rendering.
Preserve the actual RUN PARK venue: contemporary landscaped turf racecourse, broad green grass outer racing course, white horizontal safety rails on dark green posts, narrow pale cream promenade, low white concrete and dark teal fascia grandstand, mint/cream/pale-blue seating full of tiny softly painted spectators, simple broad white cantilever canopy with teal trim and thin support columns, blue sky with small clouds, soft green hills. A narrow glimpse of the secondary pale tan dirt course may appear along bottom, separated from turf by the near rail. No medieval castle, no village, no fantasy architecture, no flags copied from unrelated mockups.
Camera is a strict side tracking view perpendicular to travel, eye slightly elevated about 7 degrees; racing movement goes LEFT TO RIGHT across the screen. Main turf racing band must be unobstructed across entire width and occupy vertical band y=48% through 85%. Far grandstand occupies upper middle, near white rail sits low around 88% height. Leave broad open grass for separate character overlays. Warm upper-left sun, gentle shadows, bright premium 2D hand-painted game background with clean shapes, richer foliage and attractive natural grass texture. Background detail subordinate to foreground characters.
Designed for a repeatable horizontal scroll: left and right border have matching sky, roof height, grandstand tier heights, grass bands, rail heights and repeated column spacing. Every horizontal ground/rail band crosses both edges at SAME HEIGHT. No unique central hero building, no finish/start arch, no readable signs, no giant focal decoration or boundary wall that stops scrolling. Natural repeating modules with no obvious seam. Entire frame is filled by environment, no margins. Absolutely NO racers, mounts, foreground people, UI, arrows, text, view labels, borders, vignette, motion blur or watermarks. Single full-bleed scene, NOT multiple panels.

Use case: stylized-concept, background painting. Create ONE empty 2D racing background, tall portrait 1024x1792 (9:16 feeling). This is the REAR FOLLOW view of the SAME landscaped turf venue seen in reference 1, approaching the gentle left-hand curve at the end of its grandstand.
Reference 1 controls venue appearance and exact polished hand-painted 2D art style: teal/white contemporary grandstand, white rails on dark teal green supports, bright grass and fine pastel crowd. Reference 2 is the ACTUAL Unity track geometry and surroundings; preserve the turf course with inner pale tan dirt track, open green hills and regularly spaced leafy trees/light poles. Reference 3 MUST be used ONLY for CAMERA and sweeping left-hand CURVE composition: follow low behind a racer, broad turf in foreground narrows ahead and bends left. Do NOT copy characters, UI, castles, medieval towers, fantasy banners or architecture from reference 3.
View: camera about 3m high behind an imaginary racer, down-tilt 12 to 18 degrees, normal lens 45 degree field of view, NO horizon roll. Open unobstructed grass occupies lower 65 percent of image. Both white safety rails lead from off-frame bottom sides to a pronounced leftward bend in upper middle, strong depth, clear cornering. The inner rail at LEFT curves smoothly around the infield, with a glimpse of parallel pale tan dirt course and neatly clipped bushes farther left. The outer rail at RIGHT curves left into distance; the trailing END of the teal-and-white grandstand from ref 1 appears along upper right edge and fades into open tree-lined green hills. Same venue details, not an entirely new stadium. Fine cream walkway, muted poles, broad blue sky upper 20 percent, soft white clouds. Delicate soft painted crowd only in distant stands, no people on track. Smooth broad arc, no junction, no sharp 90 degree corner, no full oval map.
Maintain matching warm upper-left daylight and natural green palette, crisp elegant hand-painted/cel-painted 2D background; no hard low-poly facets or photo realism. Build with repeated rail/planting modules suitable for a looping corner-motion test. Leave no finish gate, start line, giant sign or unique focal object. Background only, no racer/mount/character, no UI, lettering, arrow, watermark or frame. Not a contact sheet, single full-bleed scene.

Use case: stylized-concept, background painting. Create ONE tall portrait 1024x1792 empty 2D background for a HIGH OBLIQUE AERIAL race-camera view of the SAME turf racecourse corner as the other venue references.
Reference 1 is approved venue identity/color/art style. Reference 2 is actual Unity geometry around the grandstand end and corner. Reference 3 is STRICTLY ONLY the high diagonal overhead CAMERA reference: elevated about 55 degrees down, readable wide curved race route, like viewing a section of a game world. Do NOT copy reference 3's village, buildings, fountain, UI, racers, banners or streets.
Scene identity MUST remain modern RUN PARK turf stadium: wide lush green TURF track, parallel white safety rails on dark teal-green posts, narrow cream promenade outside, tiered contemporary white concrete grandstand with teal fascia and pale teal/cream/blue seating full of tiny softly painted crowd, simple white canopy roofs, small clipped bushes and leafy trees. Tan secondary dirt oval lies inside the turf track, separated by a green buffer. Use these exact same materials as reference 1. No medieval village or castle.
Composition: camera high above looking down obliquely, NO sky, horizon or distant ground line. Show a LOCAL broad sweeping corner segment, not the whole stadium oval. A continuous approximately 17m-wide grassy race lane enters from upper left edge, sweeps diagonally through the center, then bends gently toward lower right edge. Important: travel tangent through the broad central/lower playable area is toward BOTTOM RIGHT so a separate southeast-facing character can be placed there. Two white rails clearly bound the lane; no split path or intersection. The grassy race lane occupies 55-65 percent of image and remains empty. Along the OUTER upper/right area are the END of grandstand with roof planes visible and its cream promenade; along INNER lower/left area show parallel tan dirt curve, grass strips, a few tidy low bushes, and geometric garden paths from actual Unity scene. Enough uncluttered turf in center/lower middle to place 1-4 characters, NO scene object crossing track. Refined repeated rail/planting modules for camera-motion looping experiments, no unique start/finish gateway.
High quality hand-painted 2D game background with gentle cel-painted forms and soft natural grass texture, same warm upper-left sunlight as ref 1. Clear top surfaces and foreshortening at 55 degrees, NOT eye-level, NOT vertical schematic. Single full-bleed image, no panels, labels, text, people on track, racers, animals, UI, arrows, vignette or watermark.
